column3: “Righteous” is in lowercase, and “Advocate” is capitalized.
NASB supplies “those of”; “all the world” is rendered “the whole world.”
NASB follows the critical text (with “that”), rendering it as a direct quotation.
NASB follows the critical text (“Beloved”; “which you have heard,” without “from the beginning”).
NASB ends the verse with “I have written to you, children, because you know the Father,” which the Greek numbering places at the start of verse 14; it follows the critical text (“have written”).
NASB begins the verse with “I have written to you, fathers”; the line about children is in verse 13.
NASB follows the critical text (“antichrist,” without the article); “little children” is rendered “Children.”
NASB follows the critical text (“you all know”).
NASB includes the clause “the one who confesses the Son has the Father also,” which is in the critical text.
NASB follows the critical text, without “therefore”; “As for you” renders “you yourselves.”
NASB follows the critical text (“His anointing,” “you abide”).
NASB follows the critical text (“when”); “be ashamed before Him” is rendered “shrink away from Him in shame.”
NASB follows the critical text (“also”); “has been begotten” is rendered “is born.”
